query:
SELECT pipelineStage, COUNT(*) as cnt, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN humanTakeover=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as human_takeover,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dnc=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dnc
FROM leads GROUP BY pipelineStage ORDER BY cnt DESC;
